component.name: Jigsmith
component.summary: Free parametric CAD for hobbyists and makers

description.p: Jigsmith is a parametric 3D CAD program for people who design things to 3D print, cut or build. Sketch on a plane, add dimensions and constraints, then extrude, revolve, fillet, shell and drill; change a number later and the whole design follows.
It works in millimetres or inches, opens and saves STEP, exports STL and 3MF, imports SVG and DXF drawings, and never sends anything over the network.
